title: Off-by-one index error in orders history pagination
root_cause: IndexError: list index out of range in paginate_records() when fetching order history boundary elements
visible_symptoms: GET /orders returns HTTP 500 on boundary pages
Orders log shows IndexError: list index out of range in paginate_records()
suggested_patch:
--- a/target-app/services/orders/app.py
+++ b/target-app/services/orders/app.py
@@ -155,2 +155,2 @@
-        _next_check = records[end]
+        if start >= len(records): return []
